annotations.title: Find emails, phones and social profiles on websites

description: Finds business emails, phone numbers, addresses and social profiles (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube) on any list of websites; it visits the contact and about pages itself. Use only for lawful business outreach (GDPR / CAN-SPAM). Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/contact-details on your Apify account (about $0.002 per website with contacts found; nothing found, no charge; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

max_pages_per_site.description: Pages read per website; contact, imprint and about pages are picked first.

require_email.description: Drop sites where no email was found.

name: find_website_contacts

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Find emails, phones and social profiles on websites
